preview.title: LityOS: shell Quickshell — carte du haut, lanceur, panneau du bas masqué
preview.summary:
• TopCard: theme is now owned by the card (no longer passed from shell.qml), which was undefined on device (errors at TopCard.qml 73/171/177).
• Top card (portrait, ~340 dp): Dashboard (clock/date, uptime, session, CPU, memory), Media (MPRIS, art, controls, progress, Visualiser), Performance (SysStats: CPU/RAM/temp from /proc and /sys every 2 s, CPU history).
• Visualiser: no audio source is readable with this Quickshell build, so it is a calm animation (livelier when playing). Timers run only while the card is expanded and the tab is visible.
• Launcher: bottom-centre glass card, search over DesktopEntries, opened by the rail button, closes on launch, Escape or tap outside.
• lityos-shell: sets Plasma's bottom panel(s) to autohide at start (only those on normal), records them in ~/.config/lityos/shell-panels, restores on stop / quickshell exit / lityos-shell restore (called by lityos-session when the shell is off). Panels the user changed meanwhile are left alone.
• No blur, no shader effects. shellEnabled stays off by default.

recentPreviews.title: LityOS phone v2 PR 4: rounded output and black backdrop
recentPreviews.summary:
Phone mode only (APK, no image change):
• The guest SurfaceView (inside the PR 2 margins) gets rounded corners, default 28 dp, via ViewOutlineProvider + clipToOutline. Chosen over any offscreen/per-frame work: the clip is applied by the compositor on the surface layer, so no per-frame cost in the app on the software-rendered Z Flip 7. The radius is capped to half the short side.
